brief:
Seam work inside PlaybackSessionBridge.swift only (+ new files). Behaviour identical.

STEP 1. New iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackTransport.swift: `protocol PlaybackTransport: Sendable` with exactly the 8 SiloAPI methods the bridge uses (inventory-3 §5 list: playbackV3Capability, stopPlayback, watchDetail, startPlaybackV3, reportPlaybackRouteEventV3, replanPlaybackV3, reportPlaybackProgress, syncProgress) — copy signatures from SiloAPI. `extension SiloAPI: PlaybackTransport {}` (SiloAPI is an actor; if conformance needs `nonisolated` trampolines or the methods are already usable, prefer zero changes to SiloAPI.swift and put the conformance in the new file; if SiloAPI.swift must change, list it under files_outside_package).
STEP 2. `PlaybackSessionBridge.init(transport: any PlaybackTransport = SiloAPI.shared)` storing it; replace the 15 `SiloAPI.shared.` call sites in the bridge (and in the nested `PlaybackV3CapabilityGate` actor — give it the transport too) with the stored transport. The static `reportTerminalStart` (BR:941) takes a transport parameter defaulting to SiloAPI.shared so its two callers (AudioPlayerViewModel via ApplePlaybackV3PlanAdapter.resolvePlayablePlan, and the bridge) compile unchanged — do not edit those callers.
STEP 3. `func stopSession(expectedSessionId: String, position: Double?, isPaused: Bool) async` — same body as stopSession(position:isPaused:) BR:1521 but the `guard let sid = sessionId` becomes `guard sessionId == expectedSessionId`; the existing method becomes a one-line call into it with the current sessionId (the identity-check-after-await at BR:1576 stays). Also add `var currentSessionId: String? { sessionId }` (actor-isolated getter) — wave 2 will widen this into `SessionIdentity` once the type exists (another wave-1 package defines it; do NOT define SessionIdentity here).
STEP 4. iosApp/Tests/FakePlaybackTransport.swift: `actor FakePlaybackTransport: PlaybackTransport` with scripted responses per method (decoded from the existing Fixtures/PlaybackV3/*.json via PlaybackV3FixtureTestSupport) and a recorded call log.
STEP 5. iosApp/Tests/PlaybackSessionBridgeIdentityTests.swift: the FIRST tests that construct the bridge — (a) startSession over the fixture decision_response yields a PreparedPlayback and `currentSessionId` equals the fixture session id; (b) `stopSession(expectedSessionId: "other")` is a no-op (sessionId unchanged, no stopPlayback call); (c) `stopSession(expectedSessionId: current)` clears it and calls stopPlayback once; (d) a replan over the fixture increments the attempt and keeps identity; (e) the 8-replan cap throws `attempt_limit_reached`. Keep tests deterministic (no real network, no timers).

HARD BOUNDARIES: no change to replan/renew/report logic; no new identity type; no edits outside PlaybackSessionBridge.swift + new files (SiloAPI conformance exception noted above).

deliverables.id: PlaybackSessionBridge.init(transport:) + all call sites on the injected transport

invariants: Every SiloAPI call the bridge makes is unchanged in method, arguments and order
V3 request/replan/route-event bodies byte-identical (fixture round-trip tests green)
